# Learn with Ian

> Learn with Ian is a free cartoon series on YouTube for children ages 2 to 6. Each short, calm episode teaches one idea (animals, plants, shapes, numbers, colors, weather, holidays). Every episode has a free lesson plan for preschool teachers and a free printable worksheet. Made for Kids on YouTube; no ads or tracking on the website.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://learnwithian.com/): newest episodes, free printables and lesson plans
- [All episodes](https://learnwithian.com/episodes.html): every episode with its topic
- [Free printables](https://learnwithian.com/free.html): a free worksheet for every episode and a free 6-page teacher pack (PDF)
- [Lesson plans](https://learnwithian.com/lessons.html): free circle-time lesson plans for preschool teachers
- [Teacher guide](https://learnwithian.com/teachers.html): how to use the episodes in class
- [Shop](https://learnwithian.com/shop.html): books, printables and T-shirts made from the episodes
- [Episodes in Spanish](https://learnwithian.com/es/) and [in Portuguese](https://learnwithian.com/pt/): lesson plans in Spanish and Portuguese (videos in simple English)

## Episodes
- [Christmas for Toddlers: Ian's Christmas Eve](https://learnwithian.com/ep/ian-s-christmas-eve.html): Watch Ian's Christmas Eve, a free 11-minute cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers. Children name Christmas things like a tree, star, bell, lights, present,…
- [Colors for Toddlers: Ian's Color Day](https://learnwithian.com/ep/ian-s-color-day.html): Watch Ian's Color Day, a free cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers. Children name six colors: red, blue, yellow, orange, green and purple. Free lesson plan…
- [Snow for Toddlers: Ian's Snowy Day](https://learnwithian.com/ep/ian-s-snowy-day.html): Watch Ian's Snowy Day, a free cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers. Children name winter clothes (hat, scarf, gloves, boots, coat) and say why we wear them…
- [How Plants Grow for Kids: Ian's Little Garden](https://learnwithian.com/ep/little-garden.html): Watch Ian's Little Garden, a free 9-minute cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers. Children tell the order: seed, soil, water, sun, plant. Free lesson plan…
- [Counting 1 to 5 for Toddlers: Ian's Number Walk](https://learnwithian.com/ep/number-walk.html): Watch Ian's Number Walk, a free 8-minute cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers. Children count objects from 1 to 5, one number for each object. Free lesson…
- [Learn Shapes for Toddlers: Ian's Shape Hunt](https://learnwithian.com/ep/shape-hunt.html): Watch Ian's Shape Hunt, a free 9-minute cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers. Children recognise and name a circle, a square and a triangle. Free lesson…
- [Zoo Animals for Toddlers: Ian's Zoo Day](https://learnwithian.com/ep/zoo-day.html): Watch Ian's Zoo Day, a free 15-minute cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers. Children name common zoo animals and say one thing about each. Free lesson plan…
